# API Response Information

Below is the response from an API call. To help you understand the data, I've provided:

1. A detailed description of all fields in the response structure
2. The complete API response

## Response Structure

> Content-Type: application/json

- **data**: 我的抽奖奖品列表 (Type: object)
  - **data.status**: 业务状态 (Type: object)
    - **data.status.code**: 状态码，如 SUCCESS/NOT_LOGIN (Type: string)
    - **data.status.message**: 状态文案 (Type: string)
  - **data.prizes**: 奖品列表，按中奖时间(recordTime)倒序 (Type: array)
    - **data.prizes[].id**: 奖品记录ID (Type: string)
    - **data.prizes[].name**: 奖品名称 (Type: string)
    - **data.prizes[].imageUrl**: 奖品图片 (Type: string)
    - **data.prizes[].prizeType**: 奖品类型 (Type: integer)
    - **data.prizes[].recordTime**: 中奖时间 (Type: string)
    - **data.prizes[].status**: 状态数值 (Type: integer)
    - **data.prizes[].statusText**: 状态文案 (Type: string)
    - **data.prizes[].timeRemindText**: 可用时间提醒文案 (Type: string)
  - **data.pageNum**: 当前页码（归一化后） (Type: integer)
  - **data.pageSize**: 每页条数（归一化后，最大50） (Type: integer)
  - **data.hasMore**: 是否还有下一页 (Type: boolean)
  - **data.nextCursor**: 下一页游标，无更多为空 (Type: integer)
  - **data.truncated**: 结果被截断时为 true (Type: boolean)
- **message**: 响应消息 (Type: string)
